clue.text: Number specified to attend the reception

definitions.text: Number specified to attend the reception

parts.words: Number specified to attend the reception
parts.note: a radio set is tuned to a stated figure so that the broadcast can be picked up clearly

explanation.definitionFit: A radio station is received by tuning to its stated frequency figure, so it is a number specified for good reception.

clue.text: Expert, full of a cold, unfit to present an award

indicators.note: full of means the expert contains the other letters

parts.note: an ace is an expert

indicators.note: unfit suggests the letters of a cold are out of shape and rearranged

explanation.surface: A star player with a cold is too ill to hand out a prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfit' looks like it describes the expert's health, but it signals the rearranging of 'a cold'; 'to present' is just a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An accolade is an honour or award given for merit.

clue.text: Christmas almost set up in plenty of time

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the letters are read upwards, backwards
almost means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: Noel is another word for Christmas

explanation.surface: Christmas preparations nearly done, with time to spare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts NOEL to NOE, and 'set up' turns it to read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An eon is an immensely long period, so plenty of time.

clue.text: So a peer could possibly appear with time to spare?

definitions.text: So a peer could possibly appear with time to spare?

parts.words: So a peer could possibly appear with time to spare?
parts.note: the word meaning ahead of time contains a nobleman's title at its start, so a peer shows up in it

explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'with time to spare'; the rest is a playful hint that the title of a nobleman is visible in the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Arriving with time to spare means arriving before the expected hour.

clue.text: New union member, not old, assembled insulation device

indicators.note: not means the old letter is removed

parts.note: a bridegroom is newly joined in marriage
met means gathered together

explanation.surface: A fresh trade unionist, not a veteran, put together some lagging kit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' looks like a trade union, but it is a marriage, so the member is the GROOM.
explanation.definitionFit: A grommet is a ring, often rubber, lining a hole to protect or insulate cables passing through.

clue.text: Producer of tortoiseshell tries to sell an account

parts.note: to hawk is to peddle goods
a bill is an account of money owed

explanation.surface: Someone peddles a statement of charges.
explanation.definitionFit: The hawksbill turtle's shell was the main source of tortoiseshell.

clue.text: Expert in Polish

definitions.meaning: an enthusiast who knows a lot, as in a film fan
to rub a surface until it shines

explanation.definitionFit: A buff is a knowledgeable enthusiast, and to buff a surface is to shine it by rubbing.

clue.text: Maybe rolls an unlucky number

parts.note: bread rolls counted out by a tradesman come to the figure thought unlucky, one over twelve

explanation.definitionFit: Bakers traditionally gave thirteen for twelve, and thirteen is considered unlucky.

clue.text: Enthusiasts given freedom, and replacing grass there?

indicators.note: replacing means one piece swaps in for another inside the word freedom

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass

explanation.surface: Fans given liberty might rip up the turf.
explanation.walkthrough: An unusual substitution: 'and' in the clue is the replacement itself, not a link word, and 'there' points back to freedom as the word being altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Fandom is the collective body of fans of something.

clue.text: Heartlessly carries on altering outline of plot

indicators.note: altering means the remaining letters are changed into a new order
without its heart, so the central letter of the word carries is dropped

explanation.surface: Someone callously keeps changing the shape of a story they are writing.
explanation.walkthrough: The OCR spliced in stray words; the page prints 'Heartlessly'. Dropping the middle R of CARRIES gives CARIES; with ON, 'altering' rearranges CARIESON.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenario is a sketch or synopsis of the plot of a play or film.

clue.text: Political faction imprisons a king as prelude to rising

indicators.note: imprisons means one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: a wing is one section of a political party, as in the left wing
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A group of radicals locks up a monarch as the first step to an uprising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' suggests revolt after the faction and king, but here it means getting out of bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming out of sleep is what happens before one gets up in the morning.

clue.text: Good woman accommodates first of lads with pleasure

indicators.note: accommodates means the woman takes another letter inside her

parts.note: a lady is a woman

indicators.note: first of means just the opening letter of lads is used

explanation.surface: A kind landlady is happy to put up the first of the young men.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something gladly is doing it willingly and with pleasure.

clue.text: Similar individual living very fast

parts.note: a double is a lookalike
quick means alive, as in the quick and the dead

explanation.surface: A lookalike leads a life at great speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Double-quick means at a very fast pace, from a military marching speed.

clue.text: Rapidly increase scope, after sloppy material

indicators.note: after puts the scope piece behind the sloppy material

parts.note: mush is soft pulpy stuff
scope as in room to move, space

explanation.surface: An instruction to widen one's range once the messy groundwork is done.
explanation.definitionFit: To mushroom is to grow or spread fast, like fungi popping up overnight.

clue.text: One may preen, in a tuxedo, some time after nasty taunt

indicators.note: after places the time piece at the end, behind the scrambled taunt

parts.note: DJ, short for dinner jacket, is the British name for a tuxedo

indicators.note: nasty suggests the word taunt is spoiled into a new order

parts.note: bird is British slang for a prison sentence, from rhyming slang bird-lime for time

explanation.surface: Someone in evening dress primps, a while after being insulted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' makes UTANT from TAUNT. BIRD = a jail term is British slang (rhyming bird-lime, time).
explanation.definitionFit: The adjutant is a large stork, and birds groom their feathers, so this one may preen.

clue.text: Entertainment's a necessity, hosting English soldiers

indicators.note: hosting means the necessity holds the other letters

parts.note: a must is something essential
men means ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Fun is essential, and the troops are being entertained.
explanation.definitionFit: Amusement is enjoyment or something that provides entertainment.

clue.text: Keep parking, and get booked?

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
to reserve is to book in advance

explanation.surface: A motorist keeps parking and wonders about a ticket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get booked' suggests a parking ticket, but means arranging a booking.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve something is to keep it safe or intact.

clue.text: Idler has to push ahead, touring round part of the SW

indicators.note: touring means the lunge goes around another letter

parts.note: to lunge is to thrust forward
O is round in shape
the Lizard is a peninsula in Cornwall, in south-west England

explanation.surface: A loafer is told to press on while travelling around a corner of the West Country.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lizard is the southernmost peninsula of mainland Britain, in Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: A lounge lizard is a man who idles in bars and smart rooms, seeking company.

clue.text: Cakes may have upper-class vote, to finish US state meal

indicators.note: to finish means the following letters come at the end

parts.note: GA is the abbreviation for Georgia
tea is a meal
U means upper-class in British usage
X is the mark made on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: Smart people vote to end an American state banquet with desserts.
explanation.definitionFit: Gateaux are rich layered cream cakes, the plural of gateau.

clue.text: Barge a little woman lets out

parts.note: Jo March is one of the sisters in the novel Little Women

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of lets are rearranged

explanation.surface: A small lady lets out a canal boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Barge' is the verb, to shove; 'out' rearranges LETS into STLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To barge is to push roughly into people, which is to jostle.

clue.text: Opposed to search in occupied territory

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a quest is a search

explanation.surface: Someone is against hunting around in land held by an army.
explanation.definitionFit: A conquest is land taken and held by force.

clue.text: Possibly fine effort, going about backing in

indicators.note: going about means the effort surrounds another piece

parts.note: a push is a big effort

indicators.note: backing means the word in is read backwards

explanation.surface: A good try that involves going around and shoring something up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fine' is a verb here, an example of what the answer means, hence 'Possibly'.
explanation.definitionFit: To fine someone is one way to penalise them, so the definition gives an example.

clue.text: Showing flags on deck?

parts.note: not a ship dressed with bunting but a ground covered in flagstones

explanation.definitionFit: A surface laid with flagstones is covered in paving stones on its floor.

clue.text: Starts to settle tension, before widespread conflict

indicators.note: before puts the two initials ahead of the widespread piece
starts to means the opening letters of the next two words are taken

parts.note: rife means common or widespread

explanation.surface: Advice to calm tensions first, before fighting breaks out everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Strife is bitter disagreement or fighting.

clue.text: Recommending protection for eyes during stormy day

indicators.note: during means one piece sits inside the other
stormy suggests the letters of day are tossed about

parts.note: a visor shields the eyes

explanation.surface: A forecast suggests wearing eye protection on a day of storms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stormy' also paints the weather picture, but it is the anagram signal working on 'day'.
explanation.definitionFit: Advisory means giving advice, recommending without compelling.

clue.text: Leading bowler nearly becomes a runner

indicators.note: nearly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: in the game of bowls, the skip is the team captain

explanation.surface: The top bowler almost turns into an athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: The skip captains a team in lawn bowls; a runner is a blade under a sledge.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski is a long narrow runner fixed under a boot or a vehicle for sliding over snow.

clue.text: Yank given a kind of lift in competition

definitions.text: a kind of lift in competition
definitions.meaning: in weightlifting, the clean and ... is a competition lift

explanation.definitionFit: A jerk is a sharp tug, and also the second part of the clean-and-jerk weightlifting move.

clue.text: One needed to maintain lifts for passengers

definitions.text: One needed to maintain lifts for passengers

parts.words: One needed to maintain lifts for passengers
parts.note: reads like an elevator engineer, but lifts here are rides given to paying fares

explanation.definitionFit: A cabbie keeps giving rides to fare-paying customers, lifts in the British sense of rides.
